label: Cold open
narration: Four people on one team, one goal: ship a React library for configuring Buildbarn. Dana is the dev manager, and day one is hers.

label: Task Servers intro
narration: First stop — Task Servers. RobOS connects to whatever tracker the team uses: Jira, GitHub Issues, Linear, or anything else.

label: Pass store
narration: The API token gets loaded from the password store — never pasted, never in a config file.

label: Workflow Studio intro
narration: Workflow Studio is where Dana defines how every ticket moves. She doesn't design by hand — she describes the team in English and lets RobOS draft it.

label: Workflow types
narration: Three types — Feature, Bug, Spike — each with its own pipeline and AI hooks on the states that matter.

label: Git Projects intro
narration: Git Projects registers the two repos the team will work on. RobOS detects the stack and drafts the dev-setup and test scripts.

label: Git Projects repos
narration: One for the library, one for the proto types it depends on. Both published to GitHub Packages.

label: Wrap
narration: Four minutes of config, one source of truth, every other RobOS app picks it up automatically. Dana hands off.
